techHighlights.title: 江苏高倍智能装备有限公司
techHighlights.titleEn: Jiangsu Gaobei Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
techHighlights.subtitle: 聚焦编织 • 智造复材
techHighlights.subtitleEn: Focus on Braiding • Smart Composite Manufacturing
techHighlights.description: 江苏高倍智能装备有限公司（简称「江苏高倍」），是云路复合材料集团全资子公司，坐落于江苏省盐城市盐南高新区，专注于特种纤维复合材料等智能装备研发、制造与销售领域，是集技术研发、装备制造、产品应用于一体的高新技术企业。依托集团全球领先的三维编织技术，江苏高倍致力于为航空航天、轨道交通、新能源汽车等领域提供智造高性能复合材料产品整体解决方案。
techHighlights.descriptionEn: Jiangsu Gaobei Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Yunlu Composite Materials Group, is located in Yannan High-tech Zone, Yancheng, Jiangsu Province. Specializing in R&D, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent equipment for specialty fiber composite materials, it is a high-tech enterprise integrating technology R&D, equipment manufacturing, and product applications. Leveraging the group's globally leading 3D braiding technology, Jiangsu Gaobei is committed to providing smart manufacturing solutions for high-performance composite materials in aerospace, rail transit, and new energy vehicles.

cards.title: 三维编织技术
cards.subtitle: 3D Braiding Technology
cards.description: 以科技创新为核心驱动力，与多家顶尖科研机构共同组建机械结构、自动化控制、复合材料工艺三大研发团队，持续深耕三维编织底层创新技术。以百余项行业细分领域显著领先的国家发明专利，构筑坚实技术护城河
cards.descriptionEn: Driven by technological innovation, we have jointly established three R&D teams in mechanical structure, automation control, and composite material processes with top research institutions. With over 100 leading national invention patents in specialized industry segments, we have built a solid technological moat.

cards.title: 复合成型自动化生产线
cards.subtitle: Automated Composite Molding Production Line
cards.description: 集成三维编织-铺层-缠绕-拉挤复合工艺，全流程实时协同控制，实现复材构件高效率绿色制造。
cards.descriptionEn: Integrating 3D braiding, lay-up, winding, and pultrusion composite processes with full-process real-time collaborative control for efficient and green composite component manufacturing.

solutionsPreview.title: 服务三大核心产业
solutionsPreview.subtitle: 业务版图 • 行业应用

industries.title: 航空航天
industries.subtitle: Aerospace & Defense
industries.description: 针对极端工况要求，提供包括机身肋梁、发动机喷管保护层、整流罩、机翼前缘等高强度、零缺陷关键承力件的三维立体编织解决方案。
industries.descriptionEn: For extreme operating conditions, providing 3D braiding solutions for high-strength, zero-defect critical load-bearing components including fuselage ribs, engine nozzle protection layers, fairings, and wing leading edges.

industries.title: 汽车轻量化
industries.subtitle: Automotive Lightweighting
industries.description: 助力量产与高性能赛车，定制底盘传动轴管件、车身防撞横梁、新能源电池包壳体等结构件，实现高达30%-50%的以碳代钢轻量化减重。
industries.descriptionEn: Supporting mass production and high-performance racing with custom chassis driveshaft tubes, body crash beams, and new energy battery pack housings, achieving 30%-50% weight reduction by replacing steel with carbon fiber.

industries.title: 新能源与清洁能源
industries.subtitle: New Energy & Power
industries.description: 面公司的光伏热场产品已持续量产，通过工艺的颠覆式创新，以及配套自主研发的生产设备（产线），其自动化程序处于行业最先进水平；其中托杆、埚托、坩埚预制体已经具有绝对的市场竞争优势，未来将逐步扩大市场占有率。
industries.descriptionEn: Our photovoltaic thermal field products are in continuous mass production. Through disruptive process innovation and supporting independently developed production equipment, the automation level is at the industry's most advanced level. Our support rods, crucible holders, and crucible preforms have achieved absolute market competitive advantage.

solutionsPreview.footerNote: 我们拥有完善的非标制造开发能力，亦可为 国防科工、海洋工程、轨道交通及高端医疗器械 等特种行业提供定制化复合材料工艺装备。
solutionsPreview.footerNoteEn: We have comprehensive non-standard manufacturing capabilities and can also provide customized composite material process equipment for defense, marine engineering, rail transit, and high-end medical devices.
